summary: Coming back each month now tells the truth: month-old balances are no longer ticked as fresh, and the Dashboard says when they need updating.
points: On Nov 1, the October review ticked 'Update the balances: All 10 balances are from October 2026 or later' for balances typed on Oct 1, and showed 'saved on 2026-10-01'.

A balance now counts as fresh only if it was typed in the last three weeks. The step lists what is old ('10 of 10 are more than three weeks old: Chase checking, Ally savings, ... and 6 more') and opens Update my balances. Dates read 10/1/2026.

When the oldest balance is 25 days old or more, the Dashboard's 'where you stand' card adds one line: 'Your balances: the oldest is from 10/1/2026, 31 days ago · Update ›'. The owner's three 'What to do now' cards stay as chosen.
After 'Save today's totals', the Net worth tile and page used to say only 'saved today'. They now also keep the change since last time: '+$1,200 since 10/1/2026, saved today'.
numbers: Fresh = typed in the last 20 days (was: any day in the reviewed month)

shots.caption: The October review on Nov 1. Before (left): month-old balances ticked done, a raw date. After (right): step 1 asks for fresh balances.
The Dashboard. After (right): one line says the balances are a month old, with Update ›; the Net worth tile keeps the change next to 'saved today'.
